verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an AI coding workbench, but the evidence documents no export feature, open-format output, or account-exit path. The only related item is ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR, which sets where app data is stored under `.zcode/`. That is a storage-location control, not an export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
